services.question: What services does CodeTech provide?
services.answer: We provide systems and software development, mobile apps, UX/UI design, branding, cloud solutions, system integration, and technical support.

custom.question: Do you offer custom solutions?
custom.answer: Yes. We build tailored solutions around your business needs, with scalability, performance, and daily usability in mind.

upgrade.question: Can you improve existing systems?
upgrade.answer: Yes. We assess your current systems and improve or integrate them with new solutions without disrupting your work.

support.question: Do you provide support after launch?
support.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing technical support and maintenance after launch to keep the solution stable and continuously improved.

cms.question: Can I edit the website content myself after delivery?
cms.answer: Yes. We design your website with a very simple Arabic admin panel, and we teach you with a short video how to add products, edit text, or upload new images yourself without needing a developer.
